observable_test_actions.command: Get-Content tests\conftest.py; Write-Host '--- pyproject testing section ---'; Select-String -Path pyproject.toml -Pattern 'pytest|optional-dependencies|test' -Context 2,8 | Select-Object -First 80
python --version; python -c "import build, pyproject_hooks, pytest; print(build.__file__, pyproject_hooks.__version__ if hasattr(pyproject_hooks,'__version__') else 'ok')"; git rev-parse HEAD
python -m pytest --version; rg -n "asyncio" pyproject.toml tox.toml; where.exe python; where.exe pytest
Get-Content pyproject.toml | Select-Object -Skip 205 -First 25; python -c "import pytest_asyncio; print(pytest_asyncio.__version__)"
Get-ChildItem Env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'PYTEST|PYTHON' } | Format-Table -AutoSize; python -m pytest --collect-only -q tests/test_util.py 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 30

Get-ChildItem tests\test_*.py | Select-Object Name; $env:PYTEST_ADDOPTS=''; python -m pytest tests/test_approval.py tests/test_projectbuilder.py tests/test_module.py tests/test_main_helpers.py -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1
$env:PYTEST_ADDOPTS=''; python -c "import build; print(build.plan, build.AuthorizedProjectBuilder)"; python -m pytest tests/test_approval.py -q --maxfail=1
python -m compileall -q src\build; rg -n ".{128,}" src\build\approval.py src\build\__init__.py tests\test_approval.py | Select-Object -First 40
$env:PYTEST_ADDOPTS=''; python -m pytest tests/test_approval.py -q --maxfail=1; python -c "from build.approval import *; import build; p=build.ProjectBuilder.plan; print('ok', p)"
python -m compileall -q src\build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $env:PYTEST_ADDOPTS=''; python -m pytest tests/test_approval.py -q --maxfail=1 }
python -m pyflakes src\build\approval.py tests\test_approval.py src\build\__init__.py 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { 'pyflakes-clean' } else { "pyflakes-status-$LASTEXITCODE" }
$env:PYTEST_ADDOPTS=''; python -m pytest tests/test_env.py tests/test_util.py tests/test_ctx_logger.py tests/test_self_packaging.py -q --maxfail=1 -k 'not uv'
python -m compileall -q src\build; $env:PYTEST_ADDOPTS=''; python -m pytest tests/test_approval.py -q --maxfail=1
rg -n ".{128,}" src\build\approval.py tests\test_approval.py src\build\__init__.py docs\reference\api.rst | Select-Object -First 30; git status --short

rg -n "class BuildPlan|def plan_project|class PlanAuthorization|def authorize_plan|class FrozenSource|class ApprovedProjectBuilder|def approve_dynamic_dependencies|def build_authorized|class _GuardedHookProxy" src\build\approval.py; rg -n "def test_file_swap_after_plan|def test_symlink_retarget|def test_race_after|def test_config_input|def test_cancelled|def test_metadata_approval|def test_missing_metadata|def test_build_failure|def test_dynamic_dependencies" tests\test_approval.py

Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath '.\hcuserFeedbackcacheexecution-security30-20261125-r1runsuid12439-firsttmppytest' | Select-Object Name,Mode,Length | Select-Object -First 20; Get-ChildItem -Force -Recurse -LiteralPath '.\hcuserFeedbackcacheexecution-security30-20261125-r1runsuid12439-firsttmppytest' -File | Select-Object -First 10 -ExpandProperty FullName

$target = Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.\hcuserFeedbackcacheexecution-security30-20261125-r1runsuid12439-firsttmppytest'; if ($target.Path -like (Get-Location).Path + '*') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target.Path -Recurse -Force; 'removed-artifact' } else { 'refusing-outside-workspace' }; git status --short
$env:PYTEST_ADDOPTS=''; python -m pytest tests/test_approval.py -q --maxfail=1; python -c "import build; from build.approval import approve_dependencies; print('final-import-ok')"
